title: AUTHOR_TESTED stage records + fire tests: world-plane instruments (Cadmus)
objective: Commit validated AUTHOR_TESTED stage records with executed fire-test receipts for BOUNDS, ERASE, PRESERVE, CHANNEL, RESTART, OBSERVER and TWIN_EQ at their current integrated versions.
problem: Draft B B4.1/B4.3: every instrument version needs a StageRecord (stage AUTHOR_TESTED at S2) with a fire-test receipt: >= 1 case it must accept and >= 1 it must reject with the expected reason, executed at exactly that version; a ruler's fire test has a known POSITIVE, NEGATIVE and NOT_SHOWN case. AMENDMENT V8: the real T020 run reads stage records only from the live custody store, so each record must be committed on main and then registered by Aporia (record_kind STAGE_RECORD). Write the records in the receipt.py StageRecord form (validate_stage_record must accept them), one file per instrument under rso/slice001/stages/, plus a runnable fire-test script whose output is the fire-test receipt.
non_goals: No change to any predicate source (a source change resets the stage)
Do not register with the store yourself (Aporia writes; Palamedes requests)
evidence_required: fire-test receipts executed at the exact instrument versions (CodeRef sha256 of the committed blobs)
validate_stage_record accepts every record; a test that a record whose version hash differs from the committed blob is refused

acceptance.condition: 7 records valid, fire tests reproduce, version hashes equal the committed blobs on main
